answer: Super-linear staking costs, set as C(m)=κm^α with α>1, force a Sybil cluster to commit more capital per incremental validator, while quadratic slashing L(x)=βx² converts overextension into punitive erosion. For any attack value V, choose κ,β so min_m(C(m)+L(m))>V; thus consensus security rises steeply with coalition scale, making hollow incentives vanish across the capital ridge like an island surrounded by prohibitive loss.
